_comment: WOLF v1.0 RISK-ON book — long-beta rotation leg of the regime-rotation fund. Trades ONLY when the shared cross-asset regime detector confirms RISK-ON (net of equities-up / oil-down / gold-soft / BTC-up / dollar-soft votes >= regimeThreshold). It then goes LONG beaten-down beta (riskAssets) that is turning up: 4h BULLISH backbone + 1h confirm + 24h momentum + RSI room. When the regime is RISK-OFF or NEUTRAL this book STANDS DOWN and emits no signals. Leverage clamped to maxLeverage then each asset's HL venue max. Pairs with the RISK-OFF book (wolf-risk_off-config.json) on a SEPARATE wallet. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, cooldowns, DSL via runtime-risk_on.yaml. Producer launched with WOLF_LEG=risk_on.
_persona: Regime-rotation long-beta — fires only in a confirmed RISK-ON regime, longs the beaten-down risk complex (crypto majors + growth indices) as it turns up, strict 5x, WIDE let-it-run DSL (a relief rally runs). Stands down in RISK-OFF / NEUTRAL. regimeThreshold = net cross-asset votes required to declare the regime (no single asset flips the book).
